items.title: 구찌, '크리스마스의 여왕' 머라이어 캐리와 홀리데이 캠페인
items.summary: Gucci unveiled its 2026 holiday gift campaign starring Mariah Carey, directed by Harmony Korine, featuring the new Butterfly Special Collection and the Starlet handbag line. The Butterfly collection launched online Nov 2 and expands to select stores and Cheongdam flagship from mid-November.

items.title: グッチの新型バッグ「グッチ NY トートバッグ」が登場！伊勢丹新宿店で「GucciCore」ポップアップを開催
items.summary: Gucci launched a new NY Tote Bag tied to the GucciCore 2027 Cruise collection, inspired by 70 years of brand ties to New York; a pop-up runs Nov 4-10 at Isetan Shinjuku, with a Japan-exclusive small size priced at JPY 346,500.

items.title: グッチ、マライア・キャリーを起用した新たなホリデーキャンペーンを発表
items.summary: Japanese trade coverage of the same Mariah Carey holiday campaign, framing it as blending holiday elation with Gucci's bold, playful design language for the Japanese market.

items.title: グッチ ビューティの2026ホリデーが11月4日発売 ボタニカル柄のリップやクッション
items.summary: Gucci Beauty's 2026 holiday makeup line (lipsticks, cushion compacts, Gucci Bloom fragrance gift sets with botanical motifs) launched in Japan on Nov 4, now operated under Gucci's 50-year license with L'Oreal following the 2025 beauty-unit sale.

items.title: Everyone in China recognizes Gucci. That's the problem
items.summary: Critical-angle analysis arguing Gucci's ubiquitous name recognition in China has become a liability rather than an asset; Q3 2026 directly-operated sales fell 9% on weaker mainland traffic, and the piece argues Gucci needs a clear philosophical point of view, not more content, to win back drifting shoppers.

items.source: Epoch Times Hong Kong (大紀元時報)
items.title: Gucci第三季收入跌6% 大陸市場低迷拖累復甦
items.summary: Gucci's Q3 2026 comparable revenue fell 6%, worse than the 3.3% analysts expected; Kering withdrew its guidance for a return to growth this year, citing mainland China as its most challenging region; Kering ADRs fell 12% on the news and Paris-listed shares are down about 30% year-to-date.

items.title: GUCCI都結業？GUCCI關閉香港區網上商店 顧客需前往內地版網站購買
items.summary: Gucci closed its dedicated Hong Kong e-commerce storefront; HK shoppers must now purchase via the mainland China site, prompting local headlines questioning (mockingly) whether 'even Gucci is closing down,' tying into the wider retail-rationalization narrative in the region.

items.title: "할머니 집 같아" 탄식…구찌 매장 '폐쇄 선언' 초유의 사태
items.summary: Reporting on Kering's 'ReconKering' plan to close roughly 125 Gucci stores globally by 2030; Kering's incoming leadership admitted some Gucci stores 'look like grandmother's house,' acknowledging branding failures, with Q1 Gucci sales down 8% YoY. Older item kept for context on the store-closure thread that resurfaces in Oct/Nov coverage; flagged as background, not a fresh signal.

items.title: Global Brand Ambassador #LeeKnow carries the #GucciJackie1961 on his way to Milan for #GucciPrimavera
items.summary: Gucci's own brand account posted Stray Kids' Lee Know en route to the Primavera Milan show carrying the Jackie 1961 bag; kept as a baseline ambassador-activation reference point, outside the 72h/7d freshness window, so weighted low in this pool.

items.source: X (Twitter) - LEE KNOW INTERNATIONAL fan account
items.title: the.seoul.edit IG update with Lee Know In Milan for the Gucci Primavera show
items.summary: Fan account aggregation of Instagram content showing Lee Know's series of Gucci looks during Milan Fashion Week; representative of sustained K-pop fandom amplification of Gucci ambassador activity, though dated outside this week's freshness window.

items.title: 古驰最近有什么大新闻？Demna首秀、降价40%、美妆换主，3个变化说清+FAQ
items.summary: Excluded from counted pool: repeated templated '3个维度+FAQ' posts from the same account cluster covering Gucci price cuts, Demna debut, and beauty-license change, with near-identical phrasing across dozens of near-duplicate posts -- bot/content-farm pattern per source-pool-policy bot filter. Logged only to document why Weibo volume was discounted, not counted as a vetted item.

items.title: 더쿠 - 구찌가 만원~ 구찌가 만원~~
items.summary: Long-running Korean community thread riffing on Gucci price/value jokes; undated/evergreen, included only to document that theqoo (Priority-B community source) carries persistent low-level joking chatter about Gucci pricing rather than news-driven discussion this week. Not counted as a fresh item due to indeterminate publish date beyond the 14-day window.

items.title: 구찌 시계 장단점(인증)
items.summary: DC Inside watch-gallery post discussing pros/cons of a Gucci Snake watch, noting strong brand recognition but criticizing finishing/movement quality versus same-price competitors. Undated; recorded as qualitative evidence of a persistent quality-perception complaint about Gucci watches among Korean enthusiast communities, not counted as a dated fresh item.

items.title: Gucci Sparks Backlash After Using AI Models For Milan Fashion Week Campaign
items.summary: Gucci's teaser visuals for Demna's Primavera debut, some labeled 'created with AI,' drew backlash online with users calling them 'cheap' and 'AI slop,' questioning consistency with the house's craftsmanship claims; a minority read it as deliberate commentary on luxury in the AI era. Outside freshness window but kept as background for the recurring AI-content criticism theme that still surfaces in discussion of Gucci's Nov digital campaigns.

items.title: Gucci faces backlash over AI campaign images
items.summary: Korean financial-media English edition reporting on social-media backlash to Gucci's AI-generated Milan teaser images, quoting users saying the account 'looked hacked' and the visuals 'looked cheap.' Older item retained as the clearest Korean-outlet sourcing of the AI-backlash story, relevant to today's recurring criticism of Gucci's digital-marketing judgment.

items.title: '구찌 부진' 케링, 뷰티사업 로레알에 6.6조원 매각
items.summary: Background/context item on Kering's sale of its beauty division to L'Oreal for EUR 4bn, explicitly framed by Korean press as a consequence of 'Gucci's slump'; included only as background since the Nov 4 Japan beauty product launch (item 004) is the direct operational follow-through of this deal. Outside freshness window, not counted toward buzz volume.
